schedule: fresh24-step cosine optimizer perblock; rolling adapter carries across3blocks
replay: Generic prompt-KL unchanged; at phase 1 all 3 current cards; phases 2 and 3 sample 3 distinct cards uniformly without replacement from all current and earlier cards, using separate Random(seed); held cards never enter pool.
model: exact cached HF, real lfm3_mps profile, automatic MPS FP16
HF_inner_operation_budget_s: per phase: measured first update time × 24 + 120 seconds, starting at first update; absolute total cap 1800 seconds
evaluation: baseline and each fixed24 phase:ALL9held+same8 evenly spread general, strict4 question-aware, record individual old-correct and general losses

descriptive_criteria.new_block_gain_reference: current block after phase vs immediately preceding checkpoint

native: Native evaluation if feasible without exporting any adapter; no adapter conversion or export authorized.
limitations: One tiny fictional seed; not full production-night reproduction
Native evaluation may be unavailable because native serving requires GGUF adapter conversion.
memory_measurement: vm_stat free + inactive + purgeable; speculative is included in free on macOS and must not be double-counted

scoring.scope: only facts from blocks 1 and 2, seeds 1 and 2 only for the verdict (seed 0 reported separately)
scoring.PASS: summed over seeds 1+2: ON kept >= 2x OFF kept AND each arm has >= 4 learned in total; if OFF kept == 0, ON kept must be >= 2
scoring.TOO_FEW: either arm has < 4 learned in total over seeds 1+2
scoring.FAIL: OFF kept >= ON kept (proves the claim wrong)
scoring.HARM: in any run final general hits > 2 below that run baseline
scoring.order_of_evaluation: TOO_FEW first, then HARM reported alongside, then FAIL, then PASS; anything else (enough learned, ON>OFF but under 2x) = INCONCLUSIVE
scoring.also_report: 3-seed totals including wave 1 (seed 0: ON 3 learned 3 kept, OFF 3 learned 0 kept); not used in verdict

disk_safety_r4: Before start require at least 4 GiB free on /System/Volumes/Data; abort cleanly during run if free space drops below 2 GiB.
disk_safety_r5: Start only if >=4 GiB free on /System/Volumes/Data; abort cleanly (in watcher and in run_hf before every step/eval) if free drops under 2 GiB.

arms.on: re-study ON: exactly the r3 rule (phases 2,3 sample 3 distinct cards from all current+earlier cards).
arms.off: re-study OFF: phases 2,3 train on the current block 3 cards only (no earlier cards). Everything else identical, same MPS/FP16 device, run after ON if >=600 s of the 1800 s total cap remain; OFF cap = 1800 - elapsed since ON start.

source: src copied from /Users/ben-hannan/learner-ops/premonition-research-20261029.noindex/sequential-control/src; all 33 manifest hashes verified before loading (run_hf asserts).
verdict_comparison: Primary verdict from ON arm on the fixed pass marks; OFF arm scored with same marks; report ON vs OFF on MPS as the fair comparison. HARM: final general hits more than 2 below baseline 6 (i.e. <4).
seed_controls: One integer S sets, exactly as r5 did with S=0: python random.seed(S), torch.manual_seed(S) (this fixes the LoRA A-matrix init and any torch RNG), the replay-context sampler rng=Random(S) (picks 4 generic prompt contexts per step), and the rehearsal card sampler card_rng=Random(S) (picks 3 distinct cards in phases 2-3, ON arm). Facts, held-out questions, lr, steps, grader and general questions are the same for every seed. The only code change vs r5 is run_hf.py/watch_run.py take --seed (default 0 = identical to r5); the 4 literal 0 seeds became the seed variable.
safety: Each run: free disk >=4 GiB, available mem >=7 GiB, pressure not critical (checked by watch_run). Abort if disk <2 GiB. Total wall cap 1800 s for all 4 runs; per-run cap = remaining. Isolated scratch homes per run; kill only own PIDs; no export/promotion; scratch checkpoints deleted at end.
